description: Fetch an RSS or Atom feed and return its items as JSON: title, link, date, author, categories, snippet. Whatever the feed publishes is what you get, including its idea of dates and ordering. A page that is not a feed is reported as such rather than parsed into an empty list. Network: needs the feed URL. Optional packages: rss-parser. Without them this tool reports what is missing instead of guessing.
name: get_feed
